items.html: Now, concerning the four Mochin themselves, there is a difference between them: the two Mochin called Hochma and Bina of ZA are drawn into him from the illumination drawn into them from those two upper segments of Hesed and Gevura of Arich Anpin, hidden within the Hochma and Bina of Aba and Ima; and they themselves stand above in their place. But the aspect of the third brain, called Daat, which includes the two coronets — they themselves go out and are drawn down to the head of ZA, their very substance and not merely their illumination; however, while within Aba and Ima, they were clothed there by the power of Aba and Ima, and after being clothed there, they descended below and were clothed within the head of ZA.
